origin.policy: Exact source bytes were hashed before extraction; the backup was read only. No old runtime imports are retained.

src/cipher_experiments/ciphers/common.py.modifications: Copied reviewed rotations; no runtime dependency changes.

src/cipher_experiments/ciphers/simeck64..modifications: Copied reviewed scalar SIMECK implementation and original provenance headers.

src/cipher_experiments/ciphers/present80.modifications: Copied reviewed scalar PRESENT implementation and original provenance headers.

src/cipher_experiments/ciphers/simon64.p.modifications: Copied reviewed scalar SIMON64/128 implementation and original provenance headers; independent of existing ciphers/simon.py.

src/cipher_experiments/ciphers/skinny64..modifications: Copied reviewed scalar SKINNY implementation and original provenance headers.

src/cipher_experiments/ciphers/skinny_ad.modifications: Copied the public-only SKINNY transform; it imports Torch, not data keys or model/training code.

src/cipher_experiments/ciphers/expanded..modifications: Copied reviewed chunked NumPy encryption for the four supported ciphers.

src/cipher_experiments/ciphers/tasks.py.modifications: Copied TaskSpec, public_features, and validate_public; added ordered DEFAULT_TASKS tuple and retained TASKS name lookup for direct task access. Cipher public-feature inputs contain no sample/key data.

src/cipher_experiments/data/differential.modifications: Composes bounded balanced material generation and four-pair encryption in one independent module; no cipher registry, old package imports, model, or training dependency. Groups are even and capped at 65536; seeds are built-in uint32 values.

tests/test_differential_data.py.modifications: Uses a minimal set of reviewed KAT vectors and adds small synthetic differential-data, task API, determinism, shape, balance, and bounds checks; no backup tests are collected or imported.
